rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (6 tracks) per https://paramore-music.com/menu/paramore/other-releases/, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2010_Summer_Tour_EP. Released during the 2010 Honda Civic Tour (iTunes July 20, 2010; physical August 10, 2010). Features Paramore, Tegan and Sara, New Found Glory, and Kadawatha. Per Wikipedia: tracks 1-2 are Paramore live at Wembley Arena; track 3 is Tegan and Sara live acoustic in Australia; track 4 is a previously unreleased Tegan and Sara track; track 5 is a New Found Glory B-side; track 6 is a previously unreleased Kadawatha track.
